content.content: The path to a node's document is nodes/<id>.json, derived from the id alone: no index, no search, no second layout. It is the path a read names at the owning change and a write names under the root.
content.rationale: The spec fixes the layout; deriving the path from the id alone, with no lookup structure, is what keeps location total and obvious. This is locating, not validating: the schema defines validity, S2-validate checks it, this node only finds the file.
